note.describe: What went wrong, when it failed.

model.describe: The model that ran it, like Haiku 5.5, when it is not the one this connection reports.

list_site_feedback.describe: List the reports people sent from the site's Send feedback button, newest first, filtered by status, fix soon or long term, app, and date.
say: list the open fix soon reports
show the classroom bug reports from this week

status.describe: open (new or seen, the usual), one status, or all.

horizon.describe: fix soon (the usual), long term ideas, or both.

app.describe: Only reports about this part of the site, like classroom or portal.

since.describe: Only reports filed on or after this date, like 2026-10-16.

count.describe: How many to list, newest first; leave it out for 25.

feedback_screenshot.describe: Get a link to the screenshot attached to one site feedback report, good for five minutes.
say: show me the screenshot on that report
open the picture from the matrix theme report

report.describe: The report's id, or the first eight characters of it, from the feedback list.

mark_feedback.describe: Move many feedback reports, Armory notes or Armory incidents to new, seen, resolved or spam in one call, by ids or by status, version and date.
say: resolve every new Armory incident from version 0.3.3
mark all the Armory notes as seen
set every seen report since Monday to resolved

list.describe: Which list: site reports (the Send feedback button, the usual), armory notes, or armory incidents.

ids.describe: Each one's id, or its first eight characters. Leave it out to pick by status, version and date instead.

status.describe: The new status: new, seen, resolved or spam.

currently.describe: Without ids: only the ones that have this status now, like new.

version.describe: Without ids, for the Armory lists: only those sent by this app version, like 0.3.3.

since.describe: Without ids: only those sent on or after this date, like 2026-10-22.

list_armory_reports.describe: List what the IDEA Armory app sent, incidents or notes, newest first, filtered by status, version, kind and date, with a count of each.
say: how many Armory crash reports came in today
show the Armory notes from version 0.4.1

list.describe: incidents (crash and slow pass reports, the usual) or notes people typed.

status.describe: open (new or seen, the usual), one status, or all.

version.describe: Only those from this app version, like 0.3.3.

kind.describe: Only this kind, like crash or slowPass.

since.describe: Only those sent on or after this date.

count.describe: How many to list, newest first; leave it out for 25.

read_armory_incident.describe: Read one IDEA Armory incident report whole, with its flight recorder events, phase timings and log lines, to diagnose a slow pass or a crash.
say: what happened in that slow pass report
show me the log lines of the newest crash

incident.describe: The incident's id, or its first eight characters, from the Armory incidents.
